description: ForestGuard Agent Universal is an omnichain AI + Web3 system that detects, verifies, and tokenizes deforestation incidents across Solana, Sui, TON, and other chains via ZetaChain. It integrates AI agents (Vision, Verifier, Geolocation, Packager), mints NFT/reward proofs, and synchronizes them cross-chain. Each incident report is verified, tokenized, and accessible on multiple chains. The app demonstrates true universal connectivity with onCall, onRevert, and onAbort functions enabling seamless cross-chain interactions.
goal: Build a fully functional omnichain ForestGuard Agent app that integrates ZetaChain contracts (Gateway, Universal NFT), implements onCall/onRevert/onAbort logic, supports multiple chains, has frontend/backend, agent workflows, ML inference, NFT tokenization, notifications, dashboards, and demo-ready UX for adoption and hackathon submission.

frontend.framework: React.js + Tailwind CSS + Web3 wallet SDKs (Solana, Sui, TON, Somnia)

Footer: help, hackathon credits, ZetaChain docs link
Modals: errors, confirmations, agent step details, reward claims

endpoints.description: Accepts images/metadata, triggers omnichain agent pipeline, returns incident ID, pipeline status, NFT mint hashes on Solana/Sui/TON
Returns list of incidents with filters for date, confidence, region, status, reward availability, chain
Returns detailed incident data including cross-chain NFT proofs, agent transcripts, reward status
Triggers AI agents and cross-chain minting; logs reasoning, transaction hashes, onCall/onRevert/onAbort events
Send alerts to Slack, Telegram, Email, Web3 dashboards

agentic_pipeline_logic.step1: Vision Agent detects deforestation; outputs polygons & confidence
agentic_pipeline_logic.step2: Verifier Agent cross-checks polygons with historical data
agentic_pipeline_logic.step3: Geolocation Agent calculates area & carbon impact
agentic_pipeline_logic.step4: Packager Agent generates PDF report & agent transcript
agentic_pipeline_logic.step5: ZetaChain NFT Agent mints incident report NFT on selected chains
agentic_pipeline_logic.step6: onCall: triggers cross-chain sync for NFT and metadata
agentic_pipeline_logic.step7: onRevert: handles failed mint or chain transaction rollback
agentic_pipeline_logic.step8: onAbort: cancels pipeline if unrecoverable errors occur
agentic_pipeline_logic.step9: Notification Agent sends alerts to users & dashboards

agents.name: ZetaChain NFT Agent
